text:
sarah: Heads-up — customers are reporting the deprecation banner (v1 -> v2) is triggering client retries and we're seeing route switchbacks to v1 that spike fallback quota usage. Any quick mitigation? @dina can console toggle help?
raj: Yup, logs show a lot of requests with missing `x-api-version` header. Banner flow causes some SDKs to re-invoke without preserving the header, so runtime falls back to v1. Investigating patterns now.
dina: We can flip the banner to informational-only (no UI pin/unpin action) to reduce client-initiated replays. That’s a console flag under deprecations. I can flip it in ~5m.
mike: Billing note — all fallbacks to v1 count against v1 quota. If many tenants get retried we'll see quota bursts and potential throttles. We should avoid having customers unexpectedly incur charges.
paul: Throttling will cause client retries and cascading alerts. If possible, smooth instead of hard 429s. Maybe token-per-minute smoothing per-tenant for a short window.
raj: Quick runtime idea: heuristic detect retry loops and prefer v2 when safe. e.g., if UA contains `redwood-sdk/` and request looks like a retry (same client_request_id within short window) then do a soft-fallthrough to v2 (shadow-route then promote). Draft pseudo-config:
```
route_rules:
  - name: compat-soft-fallthrough
    when:
      header_missing: x-api-version
      user_agent_contains: "redwood-sdk/"
      recent_request_same_id: true
    action:
      route_to: v2 (soft)
      inject_header: X-Redwood-Invoice-Tag: compat-grace
      sampling: 100% (featureflagged)
      ttl_seconds: 30
```
raj: That should reduce fallback load and give us tagging for billing. Feature-flag it so we can kill quickly.
sarah: I like prioritizing non-billing-impacting opt-in. @dina can we add a tenant-level "Auto-upgrade compat" toggle in the console (Routing -> Compatibility) so customers can opt in to auto-fallthrough to v2?
dina: Yes — I'll add a toggle with explanatory copy and telemetry opt-in. Default will be OFF. Copy will explain: "Enable automatic safe routing to v2 for compatible clients; helps avoid retries during v1 deprecation."
mike: For billing, propose we tag these runtime-injected requests with invoice_tag=compat-grace and zero-rate them for 30 days (or apply credits) so customers don't see surprise charges while we stabilize. We'll need a way for runtime to set the tag header so billing can pick it up.
raj: Runtime can inject `X-Redwood-Invoice-Tag: compat-grace`. I'll gate via FF and ensure header is forwarded to billing pipeline.
paul: One deploy ask — don't touch model/kernel selection or other hot paths. Keep only routing decision changed. I'll add alerting on 5xxs, 429s, and a sudden increase in v2 latency.
sarah: Plan summary and owners: Dina -> flip banner to informational now; Raj -> implement routing heuristic behind FF + header injection; Mike -> billing tag + zero-rate policy; Paul -> watch alerts and rollback if needed. Rollout window: today 14:00-16:00 PT.
dina: :thumbsup: flipping banner to informational now.
console-bot: flag updated: soft_banner_mode=info by dina at 1761239900
sarah: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a short postmortem if anything weird shows up. We'll also create a short dashboard slice: v1 fallback rate, compat-grace-tag ratio, tenant quota spikes.
